themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Multiple European countries, including Spain, Italy, and Germany, are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and policies in response to recent border crises. This theme highlights a shared transnational concern over migration, with far-right parties leveraging the issue to rally support and pressure governments for stricter controls.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands immediate repatriation of migrants from Ceuta, criticizes government's handling of the crisis, and proposes restricting healthcare for irregular migrants.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Fratelli d'Italia and Lega criticize government responses to migrant arrivals, emphasizing national security and stricter border controls.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD campaigns on anti-immigration policies, proposing stricter asylum rules and opposing EU migration pacts.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK proposes banning most benefits for foreign nationals and tightening immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Fremskrittspartiet advocates for stricter immigration policies, including deportation measures and reduced benefits for asylum seekers.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Rassemblement National criticizes Macron's immigration policies and proposes stricter controls and deportations.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe, including Germany, Sweden, Italy, and France, are making significant electoral gains, often surpassing traditional parties in polls. This theme reflects a broader trend of rising far-right influence in European politics, driven by voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads in polls for Saxony-Anhalt and Rheinland-Pfalz, with potential to secure absolute majorities in upcoming elections.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sverigedemokraterna aims for prime minister post by 2030, with leader Jimmie Åkesson positioning the party as a key player in Swedish politics.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Fratelli d'Italia and Lega see fluctuating support but remain influential, with internal leadership challenges and coalition dynamics shaping their electoral strategies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Rassemblement National leads in French polls, with Marine Le Pen positioning herself for the 2027 presidential election.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Fremskrittspartiet gains traction in Norwegian polls, focusing on immigration and economic policies to attract voters.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in the US, Argentina, Poland, and the UK are implementing or proposing cuts to social programs as part of broader fiscal debates. This theme highlights a shared focus on reducing government spending, often at the expense of welfare and public services, to address budget deficits and promote economic growth.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration proposes cuts to social programs, including healthcare and education, to reduce federal spending.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government implements austerity measures, cutting social programs and public spending to address Argentina's economic crisis.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS proposes tax changes and spending cuts, targeting social programs to reduce Poland's budget deficit.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK proposes abolishing disability benefits and cutting social programs to reduce government spending.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Poland, Italy, the UK, Spain, Hungary, and Argentina are grappling with internal divisions and leadership challenges. This theme reflects a broader pattern of instability within right-wing movements, often driven by ideological differences, personal rivalries, or electoral setbacks.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal divisions following Mateusz Morawiecki's expulsion and the formation of a new party, Rozwój Plus.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces internal dissent over Matteo Salvini's leadership, with calls for his resignation and potential splits within the party.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK experiences internal conflicts, including the suspension of key figures and public disputes over party direction.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox faces internal strife over leadership and policy directions, with factions emerging over electoral strategies and alliances.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz and Tisza face internal divisions, with former members launching new initiatives and challenging the current leadership.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: La Libertad Avanza experiences internal tensions, with factions emerging over policy directions and electoral strategies.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in the US, Poland, the UK, Spain, and Italy are intensifying their focus on LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies, often proposing restrictive measures. This theme highlights a shared transnational effort to roll back progressive policies on gender and sexuality, framing them as threats to traditional values.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration targets LGBTQ+ rights, including healthcare access and anti-discrimination protections.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS opposes progressive gender policies, framing them as threats to traditional Polish values.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK proposes rolling back LGBTQ+ rights, including restrictions on gender-affirming healthcare.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox opposes progressive gender policies, advocating for traditional family values and opposing gender-based protections.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Fratelli d'Italia and Lega criticize progressive gender policies, emphasizing traditional family values and opposing gender-based protections.
